edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the deployer-controlled caller becomes the privileged owner without validation.
onlyOwner modifier enforces require(msg.sender == owner), making msg.sender the authorization gate.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before moving ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer(msg.sender, to, tokens).
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller key.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller key.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and then forwards msg.sender to an external call.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval call.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance of the caller.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Constructor pre-mints the whole supply to the hardcoded address 0x5A86...D222.

transferOwnership stages newOwner; ownership only moves on acceptOwnership.

The unguarded subtraction consumes the _totalSupply state variable.
